recognize_zh: 這是紅血球生成示意圖（非形態學影像），以電子顯微鏡照片呈現骨髓中 CFU-E、前紅血球母細胞到正染性紅血球母細胞的成熟過程，並標示各階段導致慢性貧血的機轉：EPO 依賴與 Fas 相關凋亡、DNA 合成障礙造成巨球性、血紅素調控抑制因子造成小球性。
features: Schematic of erythropoiesis from HSC and CMP to BFU-E and CFU-E in the bone marrow
Electron micrographs of proerythroblasts, basophilic, polychromatic, and orthochromatic erythroblasts showing progressive nuclear condensation and cell size reduction
Blood panels showing reticulocytes and mature biconcave red cells
Annotations: EPO dependence and increased Fas at CFU-E/proerythroblast stage; FasL, TRAIL, TNF-alpha leading to apoptotic erythroblasts
Annotations: impaired DNA synthesis causing macrocytosis and heme-regulated inhibitor causing microcytosis during hemoglobinization
describe_en: This non-morphologic schematic depicts erythroid differentiation from hematopoietic stem cells through BFU-E and CFU-E to proerythroblasts, basophilic, polychromatic, and orthochromatic erythroblasts, reticulocytes, and mature red cells, illustrated with electron micrographs. It maps mechanisms of chronic anemia to specific stages: the EPO-dependent CFU-E to early erythroblast stages are vulnerable to apoptosis mediated by FasL, TRAIL, and TNF-alpha, as in anemia of inflammation; DNA damage and impaired DNA synthesis in later stages cause macrocytosis; and unpaired globins, oxidative damage, and heme-regulated inhibitor activity during hemoglobinization cause microcytosis. The key concept is that the stage at which erythropoiesis fails determines red cell size and the type of anemia.
